data.name: Cascadou
data.detailed_description:
Cascadou is a delightful chain‑reaction deck builder where poker hands topple into each other like dominoes. Each round raises the target score, so plan your sequence, trigger explosive cascades, and use smart upgrades to keep your run alive.

Find and explode poker hands

Playing Cascadou is easy! Clicking a card automatically plays the connected poker hands, but with limited moves per round you need to plan, create and execute the biggest scoring hands to survive for seven days.

Upgrade your deck

Your standard 52‑card deck can be upgraded with collectible stickers: from simple score boosts, to hand‑specific synergies, to wild mechanic‑benders that transform cards or even the rules themselves.

Set up and set off powerful chain reactions

Tackle optional challenges to earn badges that permanently power up your hands, and discover special cards with abilities of their own. Unlock new modes and secrets as you play.


FEATURES

  • 110+ stickers to collect, combine, and experiment with

  • 8 special cards for wild combos

  • 10 badges that permanently upgrades your run

  • Gold, Silver and Bronze medals for the completionist

  • Multiple play modes for beginners and advanced players

  • Daily Challenges: Chill Mode (free swaps, chase the longest chains) and Solitaire (remove all 52 cards in 20 moves or less)

  • Morning, Afternoon, and Night stages with optional challenges and big rewards

  • 20 rounds plus a tough final level that tests your deck and your skill

  • Secrets to uncover and new modes and stickers to unlock

  • Handcrafted art and music by solo developer machineboy from Norway

  • High replayability with endless deck, sticker, and badge combos

So, take off your shoes, kick back and soak in the delightful chain reactions of Cascadou!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i3
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL 2.1 compatible graphics card, integrated graphics
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 600 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: Lower screen resolution if performance is low
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Processor: Steam Deck or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia 2000-series or better
  • Storage: 1000 MB available space

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires an Apple processor
  • OS: macOS Sequoia 15
  • Processor: Apple M1 or better
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Turn down resolution in settings if gameplay is jerky
